svg.aria-label: PYA: Protect Your Ass, a security audit for Claude Code. While the three bots sleep by the PYA hut, a masked thief tiptoes in, leaves a backdoored package at your app's door, slaps a note on the wall telling AI reviewers to give the repo 100 out of 100, and fishes a key out of the .env window. Someone types /pya, the alarm flashes, the bots run out, sweep a scanner beam and stamp all three: leaked, backdoor, nice try. The thief bolts, a chase crosses the screen, a cage drops on him and an achievement pops up: ass protected.
